newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey plans $7.5-billion city near Istanbul.
newsitem.headline: Turkey plans $7.5-billion city near Istanbul.

text.p: Turkey is planning to establish a city near Istanbul that will cost it about $7.5 billion, Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller said on Thursday.
"The project will be realised with a partnership between Turkey and France," she told reporters. "An agreement to that end has been signed," she said.
"It will turn the region into a Singapore-like place," she said.
She said the exact location of the city would be determined soon by the treasury and housing ministry. She did not give other details.
